scripts.postinstall: node -e "import('./scripts/lib/terrestrial-catalog-lib.mjs').then(async l=>{const r=await fetch('https://www.acma.gov.au/sites/default/files/2026-07/BroadcastTransmitterExcel.zip',{redirect:'follow',signal:AbortSignal.timeout(20000)});if(!r.ok)throw new Error('ACMA '+r.status);const z=l.unzipEntries(Buffer.from(await r.arrayBuffer()));const x=[...z.entries()].find(([n])=>/\.xlsx$/i.test(n));if(!x)throw new Error('no xlsx');const sheets=l.parseXlsxSheets(x[1]);const s=sheets.find(s=>/^am$/i.test(String(s.name).trim()))||sheets.find(s=>/\bam\b|mf/i.test(s.name));if(!s)throw new Error('no AM sheet');if(s.rows.length<100)throw new Error('AM rows '+s.rows.length);const hi=s.rows.findIndex((row,i)=>i<30&&row.some(v=>/callsign/i.test(String(v)))&&row.some(v=>/frequency/i.test(String(v))));if(hi<0)throw new Error('no header row');console.log('ACMA workbook parse ok',s.name,s.rows.length,hi,s.rows[hi].join('|'))}).catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)})"
